record.question: Which of the following statements about the Execution of Warrants is NOT correct according to the Mizoram Police Manual,2005?
options: Execution of a warrant of arrest shall never be delayed.
The Officer-in-Charge may endorse the warrant to some other Police Officer including a Constable.
The person arrested shall be forwarded without unnecessary delay to the court before which he is required by law to be produced.
A warrant after execution may not be returned to the issuing court.
record.explanation: A warrant must be returned to the issuing court after execution.
